proposition: The letters as listed on pdf pp.155-163 include none identified as addressed to Pīr Muḥammad b. ʿUmar Shaykh, although MK names him as Ibn Turka's first patron in the Shiraz-Isfahan period; nothing on these pages shows what Ibn Turka offered him or received.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: An attested silence on the pages read, not a claim that no such letter exists
